title: Loan Protector
tagline: A New Form of Limit Orders to protect your DeFi Borrow Positions.
description: The current DeFi lending and borrowing market revolves around in multi ecosystem space where we are offered variable forms of yields on different kinds of assets. I propose to develop a Limit Order based framework for borrowing positions whereby one could specify conditions on parameters such as Collateral Value, Debt Value, Loan-to-Value Ratio and Health Factor by attaching a asset which want to supply or deposit at a later period.
how_its_made: The project's smart contracts are developed in solidity with the use of Foundry. Currently, Limit orders can be created based on Aave Platform's conditions. The contracts are developed in a such to have cross-chain asset attachment whereby you could potentially deposit asset parked in a different chain and supply before a catastrophic event such as liquidation happen.
